headline: Blanked, but with chances
record_line: Yesterday: 0-4 on the top plays · Season: 31-130

entries.headline: Shohei Ohtani stayed in the yard
entries.story: Shohei Ohtani went 1-for-4 against Keider Montero and the Detroit Tigers. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Kyle Schwarber came close
entries.story: Kyle Schwarber went 1-for-5 with 1 RBI against Ryan Johnson and the Los Angeles Angels. Closest call was a double in the 10th: "Kyle Schwarber doubles (17) on a fly ball to left fielder Jose Siri, deflected by center fielder Mike Trout. J.T. Realmuto scores. Justin Crawford to 3rd." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Willson Contreras came close
entries.story: Willson Contreras went 1-for-2 with 2 BB and 1 RBI against Max Fried and the New York Yankees. Closest call was a triple in the 8th: "Willson Contreras triples (3) on a line drive to right fielder Spencer Jones. Wilyer Abreu scores." The power showed up; the carry did not.
